summary.en: Stock futures rose in premarket as investors awaited the key CPI inflation report at 8:30 AM ET. Oil prices climbed near $106 following Aramco strike supply concerns, while BlackRock shares jumped on positive catalysts. Mixed sentiment with growth stocks holding steady ahead of rate-sensitive positioning.
summary.zh: 盘前股市期货上涨，投资者等待上午 8:30 ET 的关键 CPI 通胀报告。受沙特阿美罢工供应担忧影响，油价升至近 106 美元，BlackRock 股份因积极催化剂而上涨。成长股持稳，整体情绪混合。

title.en: US Stock Futures Rise Ahead of CPI Data; BlackRock Jumps on Positive Catalyst
title.zh: 美股期货在 CPI 数据前上涨；BlackRock 因积极催化剂而跳涨

impact.en: Pre-market rally suggests risk appetite despite inflation concerns. BlackRock's move signals institutional confidence in growth sectors.
impact.zh: 盘前反弹显示尽管通胀担忧，风险偏好仍存。BlackRock 的举动表明机构对成长板块的信心。

macroRisk.en: No - CPI data will be the key driver; inflation concerns may persist but supply-side oil dynamics dominate headline risk.
macroRisk.zh: 否 -CPI 数据将是关键驱动因素；通胀担忧可能持续，但供应端油价动态主导头条风险。

title.en: Oil Climbs Near $106 Following Aramco Strike; Energy Sector Under Spotlight
title.zh: 沙特阿美罢工后油价升至近 106 美元；能源板块受关注

impact.en: Supply constraints from Middle East tensions create inflation hedge demand. Higher oil prices may pressure consumer spending but support energy stocks.
impact.zh: 中东紧张局势造成的供应约束创造了对通胀对冲的需求。较高的油价可能会压制消费支出，但支持能源股票。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Geopolitical supply shock → inflation expectations → Fed policy implications. Oil prices feed into PCE data at 2:00 PM ET.
macroRisk.zh: 是 -地缘政治供应冲击→通胀预期→美联储政策含义。油价将影响下午 2:00 ET 发布的 PCE 数据。

title.en: AI and Semiconductor Stocks Mixed; ASML and TSMH Under Observation
title.zh: AI 和半导体股票分化；ASML 和台积电受关注

impact.en: Chip supply chain resilience tested amid geopolitical tensions. AI infrastructure investments continue despite macro uncertainty.
impact.zh: 芯片供应链韧性在中东紧张局势下受到考验。尽管宏观不确定性，AI 基础设施投资仍在继续。

macroRisk.en: No - AI demand fundamentals remain strong; geopolitical supply chain risks are secondary to product momentum.
macroRisk.zh: 否-AI 需求基本面依然强劲；地缘政治供应链风险是产品动量的次要因素。

title.en: S&P Futures at 7,871.25 (+0.3%); Nasdaq Watching Earnings Catalysts
title.zh: 标普期货至 7,871.25（+0.3%）；纳斯达克关注盈利催化剂

impact.en: Major indices positioning ahead of inflation report. Technology sector cautious while defensive sectors attract capital flows.
impact.zh: 主要指数在通胀报告前布局。科技板块谨慎，而防御性板块吸引资本流动。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Inflation print will determine market direction. Fed speakers and rate-sensitive valuations at risk.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 通胀数据将决定市场方向。美联储讲话和利率敏感估值面临风险。

title.zh: 预计 CPI：月度 0.6%，年度 3.6%（预测）

impact.en: Critical data point for Fed policy calibration. Lower than expected prints support risk assets, higher readings trigger defensive rotation.
impact.zh: 对美联储政策校准的关键数据点。低于预期的读数支持风险资产，较高的读数触发防御性轮动。

macroRisk.en: Critical - All macro positions depend on this release. Could trigger rate-sensitive stock rotation.
macroRisk.zh: 关键 - 所有宏观头寸都取决于此发布。可能触发利率敏感型股票的轮动。

ai.en: AI sector showing mixed signals. NVIDIA and AMD holding steady on strong demand, while smaller cap AI plays face valuation compression risks. Infrastructure build-out continues but pace moderating as chip supply constraints ease.
ai.zh: AI 板块显示混合信号。NVIDIA 和 AMD 在强劲需求下保持稳定，而小型资本 AI 投资面临估值压缩风险。基础设施建设仍在继续，但随着芯片供应约束缓解，速度放缓。

semiconductor.en: Semiconductor sector cautious. ASML and TSMH under observation for geopolitical supply chain implications. Demand remains robust but geopolitical tensions create inventory caution. Watch TSMH, ASML, NVDA.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体板块谨慎。观察 ASML 和台积电的地缘政治供应链影响。需求仍然强劲，但地缘政治紧张关系创造了库存谨慎态度。关注台积电、ASML、NVIDIA。

bigTech.en: Big Tech holding steady with selective positioning. Microsoft and Google on stable cloud growth trajectory, while Amazon faces consumer spending pressure.META adjusting ad spend amid macro uncertainty.
bigTech.zh: 大科技保持稳定，选择性布局。微软和谷歌在稳定的云增长轨迹上，而亚马逊面临消费支出压力。Meta 在中宏观不确定性中调整广告支出。

energy.en: Energy sector rally driven by geopolitical supply shocks. Oil near $106 provides profit-taking opportunities but supply constraints support prices. XLE, CVX, COP positioned favorably on inflation hedge demand.
energy.zh: 能源板块上涨由地缘政治供应冲击驱动。油价接近 106 美元提供获利了结机会，但供应约束支持价格。在通胀对冲需求上，XLE、CVX、COP 定位有利。

ev.en: EV sector faces mixed headwinds. TSLA holds ground despite macro uncertainty, but supply chain constraints and higher input costs pressure margins. Chinese EV competition intensifying globally.
ev.zh: 电动车板块面临混合逆风。TSLA 尽管宏观不确定性仍保持地位，但供应链约束和较高的投入成本压力利润边际。中国电动汽车竞争在全球范围内加剧。

market.en: Broad market positioning cautious before inflation report. S&P futures at 7,871.25 suggest steady open with risk-on bias if CPI supports soft-landing narrative. Defensive sectors attract capital flows.
market.zh: 在通胀报告前，整体市场定位谨慎。标普期货至 7,871.25 表明如果 CPI 支持软着陆叙事，将呈现稳定的开盘和风险偏好。防御性板块吸引资本流动。

preciousMetals.en: Gold and silver benefiting from safe-haven demand amid geopolitical tensions. Inflation hedge positioning supports precious metals even as Fed maintains higher-for-longer rhetoric. XAU maintaining defensive positioning.
preciousMetals.zh: 金银从中东紧张局势中的避风港需求中受益。即使美联储维持更高利率的言论，通胀对冲定位仍支持贵金属。XAU 保持防御性定位。

oil.en: WTI/Brent climbing near $106 following Aramco strike news. Supply constraints from geopolitical tensions dominate pricing dynamics. Higher oil prices create inflation expectations that feed into Fed policy calibration.
oil.zh: WTI/布伦特原油在沙特阿美罢工新闻后升至近 106 美元。地缘政治紧张关系造成的供应约束主导定价动态。较高的油价创造了通胀预期，并将影响美联储政策校准。

futures.en: S&P Futures up +0.3% at 7,871.25; Nasdaq mixed on earnings concerns; Dow steady. Asia markets (Japan/Korea) positive heading into US session.
futures.zh: 标普期货上涨 +0.3% 至 7,871.25；纳斯达克因盈利担忧而混合；道指稳定。亚洲市场（日本/韩国）在美国交易时段前呈正面。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yields hovering near 4.1-4.2%. CPI print at 8:30 AM ET will be critical for rate-sensitive positioning. Fed speakers later in day may move rates.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期国债收益率在 4.1-4.2% 附近徘徊。上午 8:30 ET 发布的 CPI 将对利率敏感型定位至关重要。今日晚些时候的美联储讲话可能会影响收益率。

dxy.en: DXY steady near 99-100 range. Dollar strength impacts EM assets and multinationals. Fed policy expectations support USD but inflation concerns provide some weakness.
dxy.zh: 美元指数稳定在 99-100 范围附近。美元强势影响新兴市场资产和多国企业。美联储政策预期支持美元，但通胀担忧造成了一些弱势。

oil.en: WTI climbing toward $106 post-Aramco strike. Brent near $112. Supply constraints from geopolitical tensions create supply shock premium. OPEC+ monitoring capacity.
oil.zh: WTI 在沙特阿美罢工后向 106 美元上涨。布伦特原油近 112 美元。地缘政治紧张关系造成的供应约束创造了供应冲击溢价。OPEC+ 正在监测产能。

keyRisk.en: CPI inflation print at 8:30 AM ET is the day's defining risk. Market direction depends on whether data supports soft-landing narrative or confirms inflation stickiness. Fed speakers will provide additional clarity.
keyRisk.zh: 上午 8:30 ET 发布的 CPI 通胀数据是今天的主要风险。市场方向取决于数据是否支持软着陆叙事或证实通胀粘性。美联储讲话将提供额外的清晰度。

note.en: Mixed sentiment before critical inflation data. Risk-on if CPI prints soft; defensive positioning if inflation stickiness confirmed. Oil supply shocks and geopolitical tensions create sector divergence.
note.zh: 在关键通胀数据发布前，情绪混合。如果 CPI 打印软着陆，风险偏好上升；如果证实通胀粘性，防御性定位。石油供应冲击和地缘政治紧张关系造成板块分化。
